                            NORTH TAHOE FIRE PROTECTION DISTRICT
                                           Board of Directors
                                            Regular Meeting
                                 NTFPD Station 51 Public Safety Center
                                222 Fairway Drive, Tahoe City, California

                                                       Tuesday
                                              October 27, 2026 – 3:00 p.m.

                                                           AGENDA

     1.  Call to Order/Roll Call
     2.  Additions to Agenda/Approval of Agenda
     3.  Pledge of Allegiance
     4.  Public Comment - Members of the public may address the Board (please limit to three
         minutes); however, any matter that requires action will, unless an emergency exists, be
         referred to Staff for a report and action at a subsequent meeting. Public comment will be
         taken on each agenda item.
     5. Approval of Minutes from the regular Board meeting held September 22, 2026
     6. Correspondence
     7. Placer County Local Agency Formation Commission Call for Nominations – Alternate
         Special District Representative
     8. Consider Resolution 16-2026 in Appreciation of Captain Jamye Stowell
     9. Consider Resolution 17-2026 in Appreciation of Battalion Chief Sarah Lagano
     10. Consider Resolution 18-2026 Authorizing the Board President and the Fire Chief, or His
         Designee, to Enter Into a Five-Year Lease Purchase Agreement for One (1) Ambulance
         Remounted on a New 2026 Chassis (M-116)
     11. Consider Resolution 19-2026 Authorizing the Fire Chief, or His Designee, to Enter into
         the Agency Funding Agreement from the Truckee-Tahoe Airport District to Fully Fund
         the River Road Project 0, Fuels Reduction Project in the Amount of $400,000
     12. Consider Adopting the Revised North Tahoe Fire Protection District Conflict of Interest
         Code
     13. Finance Reports
         13.1 Purchases Journal
         13.2 CalCard Report
         13.3 Gross Payroll Report
         13.4 Account Detail Report
     14. Staff Reports
         14.1 Fire Chief
         14.2 Division Chief - Operations / Training
         14.3 Division Chief - Fire Marshal / Forest Fuels / Facilities

Public Participation is encouraged. In compliance with Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C.
Sec 12132) and in compliance with the Ralph M. Brown Act, if you need special assistance to enable you to attend and
participate in this meeting or if you need the agenda or related materials in an alternative format please contact the Clerk of the
Board at 530-583-6911 at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting.

Se fomenta la participación pública. En cumplimiento con la Sección 202 de la Ley de Estadounidenses con Discapacidades de
1990 (42.C. Sección 12132) y en cumplimiento con la Ley Ralph M. Brown, si necesita asistencia especial para permitirle asistir
y participar en esta reunión o si necesita la agenda o materiales relacionados en un formato alternativo, comuníquese con el
secretario de la Junta al 530-583-6911 con al menos 24 horas antes de la reunion.

         14.4 A Shift Battalion Chief - Emergency Medical Services
         14.5 B Shift Battalion Chief - Logistics
         14.6 C Shift Battalion Chief – Safety
     15. Next Board Meeting and Other Important Dates
     16. Board Comments/Information Items
     17. CLOSED SESSION ITEMS:
             a. Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2), Conference
                with Legal Counsel - Exposure to Litigation, One Case
     18. Report from Closed Session
     19. Adjournment
